provenance.paper_title: From Abstraction to Instantiation: Learning Behavioral Representation for Vision-Language-Action Model

representation_paths.memory_component: Behavior Memory Bank of scene-invariant behavioral prototypes distilled from demonstrations

evidence.section: Full paper (arXiv HTML v2): Sec. 3.2.2 Behavior prototype construction and retrieval; Eq. 6; Fig. 2
evidence.paraphrase: A bank of behavior prototypes is built by temporal mean pooling of behavior tokens (z_proto = 1/T sum_t h_t^z) over offline demonstrations, where behavior tokens come from spatial multimodal fusion of the vision and action streams (Sec. 3.2.1). At deployment a query q = MLP(Phi(O_0, L)) formed from the initial observation and the instruction selects the top-K prototypes by dot-product similarity with softmax weighting, and the aggregated prototype latent is injected as a behavioral prior that conditions action generation. The stored items are compressed latent vectors, not text or retained frames, and the demonstrations behind them are not recoverable from the bank.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (arXiv HTML v2, Sec. 3.2.2 / 3.4, Fig. 2): the Behavior Memory Bank is constructed entirely in offline Phase-1 manifold learning (L_Stage1 = L_rec + alpha L_global + beta L_local, Eq. 13) and Phase-2 prior-guided policy tuning; at deployment the bank is read-only. Figure 2 states retrieval is performed once at the start of each episode and the retrieved prototype stays fixed during execution. This is the guide's canonical T1 case of a skill library formed before downstream use and thereafter only queried. The Limitations section lists dynamic prototype-bank updating through self-supervised exploration as future work, confirming no deployment-time write, maintenance, or policy change exists.

Retrieval embeddings here are not merely an index: the aggregated prototype latent is itself supplied downstream as a conditioning signal, so it is annotated as an operative latent representation path rather than an index-only embedding.
